objective: Test whether completed Deribit option aggressor transactions imply repeatable delta-hedging or gamma-rebalancing pressure in Bybit BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT after conservative cross-provider delay and executable BBO costs.

chronological_stages.development_note: 2023-01-01 was opened previously for schema and bounded source inspection only; no strategy labels, thresholds, PnL or candidate outcomes were computed before this contract was frozen.

data_contract.provider: Tardis normalized first-day monthly keyless datasets
data_contract.integrity: full gzip CRC read, byte count and SHA-256 for every source
data_contract.deribit_signal_clock: local_timestamp and row order within the common Deribit collection region
data_contract.cross_provider_execution_clock: maximum included Deribit exchange timestamp plus 2 seconds, then first Bybit exchange-timestamped BBO

greek_reconstruction.instrument_scope: BTC and ETH European options with remaining life from 1 hour through 14 days
greek_reconstruction.underlying_proxy: last valid same-underlier Deribit perpetual BBO midpoint available before each option trade in local capture order, maximum age 2 seconds
greek_reconstruction.pricing_formula: Black-Scholes forward option value in base-asset units with zero discounting
greek_reconstruction.implied_volatility_solver: fixed bisection over 1% to 500%, rejecting prices outside no-arbitrage bounds

flow_features.signed_delta_demand_usd: aggressor sign times option amount times reconstructed delta times underlying
flow_features.dealer_gamma_1pct_usd: negative aggressor sign times option amount times gamma times underlying squared times 0.01
flow_features.premium_notional_usd: option amount times premium in base units times underlying
flow_features.underlying_response: Deribit perpetual midpoint log return over the identical completed local-time window

families.name: signed_delta_flow_continuation
families.direction: sign of completed signed delta demand
families.mechanism: option taker delta demand not fully reflected in the underlying creates subsequent hedge-pressure continuation

families.name: short_gamma_momentum_amplification
families.direction: sign of completed signed delta demand
families.mechanism: dealer-short-gamma inventory can require same-direction rebalancing after an underlying move

families.name: long_gamma_excursion_reversal
families.mechanism: dealer-long-gamma inventory can require opposing rebalancing after a price excursion

families.name: failed_delta_pressure_reversal
families.mechanism: large option delta demand with flat or opposite underlying response indicates absorbed or informationally weak pressure

families.name: btc_eth_relative_option_flow_divergence
families.direction: signed delta direction of the underlier with the stronger prior-normalized option-flow innovation
families.mechanism: opposite BTC and ETH option-flow pressure identifies a relative information state rather than common crypto beta

frozen_candidate_grid.threshold_learning: asset-and-window thresholds estimated only from the four fit dates

execution_and_cost_contract.entry: long at first eligible ask or short at first eligible bid after the 2-second boundary
execution_and_cost_contract.exit: opposing executable BBO at the fixed diagnostic horizon
execution_and_cost_contract.funding: not separately material over 10 to 300 seconds; exact funding required before any longer-horizon or rank-eligible result

conditional_next_stage.if_zero_survivors: record reusable negative evidence, keep 2024-2026 sealed and retire this exact transaction-flow dependency
conditional_next_stage.if_survivors: freeze one low-dimensional family before opening any 2024 data; broaden pre-2024 monthly samples and independently verify Greek reconstruction first

prohibitions: no 2024, 2025 or 2026 access in this workflow
no same-message, same-window or pre-delay Bybit entry
no local_timestamp comparison across Deribit and Bybit collection regions
no parameter change after development opens
no cumulative ranking insertion from this fatal screen
